## Last-checked: 2026-08-26

# ellmos-filecommander-mcp - MCP Server for Filesystem and Process Access

> FileCommander is a comprehensive MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI assistants full filesystem access, bounded multi-file content search, default-app path opening, process management, interactive shell sessions, and async filename search capabilities. 49 tools in a single server -- everything an AI agent needs to interact with the local system. Part of the ellmos MCP family alongside codecommander and clatcher.

Why it exists: most filesystem MCP servers only cover basic read/write. FileCommander goes further with Safe Delete (Recycle Bin on Windows, Trash on macOS/Linux instead of permanent deletion), read-only literal or regex search across an explicit ordered list of files, validated local file/directory opening through the operating system default application (`fc_open_path`), interactive REPL sessions (Python, Node.js, shells) accessible through the MCP protocol, async search of large directory trees running in the background while the AI continues other work, process management (list, start, terminate), string-replace editing with context validation, format conversion across JSON / CSV / INI / YAML / TOML / XML / TOON, ZIP archive create/extract/list, SHA-256 / MD5 / SHA-1 / SHA-512 checksums with compare, optional tesseract.js OCR for image text extraction, runtime language selection and introspection (i18n de/en/es/zh/ja/ru), global safety mode to route all deletes through Recycle Bin / Trash, and Markdown-to-HTML/PDF export. Cross-platform with platform-specific optimizations.

Node.js >= 20, MIT. Published as `ellmos-filecommander-mcp` on npm and indexed by jsDelivr; registries may briefly lag behind the current release. Visible on LobeHub as an MCP server. Listed on Glama at https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/ellmos-ai/ellmos-filecommander-mcp. README/package metadata are the canonical current 49-tool source for the repository. Official MCP Registry name: `io.github.ellmos-ai/ellmos-filecommander-mcp`. Discovery files: `server.json` for the MCP Registry, `glama.json` for Glama-compatible MCP directories, and this `llms.txt` for LLM/documentation crawlers.

`fc_search_content` searches at most 50 explicit UTF-8 text files in input order. Literal matching is the default; regex, case sensitivity, context lines, global limits, and per-file limits are optional. It performs no recursion or glob expansion, skips binary and files over 10 MB, reports partial per-file errors, redacts common secret formats, and returns deterministic bounded JSON.

## Audience

- **AI engineers** integrating local filesystem tools into Claude Desktop, Claude Code, or custom MCP clients
- **Developers** who want safe-delete, OCR, ZIP, session management, or cloud-lock-safe file ops in their AI workflows
- **Power users** running Claude Code or similar agents and wanting full OS-level file access via MCP
- **Teams** deploying AI assistants on Windows/macOS/Linux that need cross-platform filesystem control
- **Security-conscious users** who want Recycle Bin / Trash semantics and a global safety mode before any deletion

## ellmos MCP family (sibling servers)

- [ellmos-codecommander-mcp](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-codecommander-mcp): Code analysis, AST parsing, import management (22 tools)
- [ellmos-clatcher-mcp](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-clatcher-mcp): Utility tools -- repair, convert, detect, batch ops (12 tools)
- [n8n-manager-mcp](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/n8n-manager-mcp): n8n workflow management via MCP (19 tools)
- [ellmos-controlcenter-mcp](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-controlcenter-mcp): MCP stack discovery, profile management, and control plane (31 tools)
- [ellmos-homebase-mcp](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-homebase-mcp): LLM memory, knowledge, state, routing, and orchestration (45 tools)
- [ellmos-servercommander-mcp](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-servercommander-mcp): Server deployment, health checks, and mail access tools (8 tools)
- [ellmos-blender-use-mcp](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-blender-use-mcp): Headless Blender asset QA and FBX reimport verification (5 tools)
- [open-compute-mcp](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/open-compute-mcp): Model-agnostic computer use and OS interaction (16 tools)

## Broader ellmos ecosystem

- [BACH](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/bach): Full text-based OS for LLMs -- primary consumer of the MCP servers
- [Rinnsal](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/rinnsal): Lightweight LLM agent infrastructure
- [clutch](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/clutch): Multi-provider AI routing and failover
- [USMC](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/usmc): Shared memory primitive
